skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and role of international accounting, its formation and development, and the diversity of international accounting systems and factors influencing their development.
Understand the differences in financial reporting in multinational companies and apply methods for converting international financial reports and consolidating financial statements.
Understand international taxation methods for multinational companies.
Identify management accounting methods for specific content in multinational companies.
Identify differences in international auditing and international auditing standards.
Apply critical thinking skills to analyze and evaluate issues in the context of accounting.
Demonstrate effective communication skills in writing reports and presenting professional content.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic work environment.
Demonstrate adaptability in a changing work environment.
Demonstrate personal responsibility and accountability in group work.
